question:
Select the figure thet will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15057d7fc6d4ae343062228aba51951361a1414f1e95a49bfe28843e2009be2b.png]
solution:
In the given series:

** The pattern changes in rows and columns alternatively.**

 
• **In rows, the top row shift to middle, middle row shifts to bottom and bottom row shifts to top.**
 
• **In columns, the right column sifts to left, left shifts to middle and middle shifts to right.**

**​**So the next step will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38321668ef4c08439a22625ea43dda711e49cab80e216b945829ffeefe0130b8.png] 

Now we consider the given options:

Option 1) The arrangement of rows are wrong.

Option 2) ) The pattern matches completely.

Option 3) The arrangement of rows and columns are wrong.

Option 4) The arrangement of rows are wrong.

Hence **the correct answer is option 2)**
